description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: L-shaped sofa in living area facing inward toward TV on opposite wall; dining table with four chairs near the upper exterior wall. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 1 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households requiring two full bathrooms; those needing wheelchair-friendly wide circulation due to the narrow elongated layout.
